card.name: Dynasty or era names after "the"
card.fires_on: Proper adjectives or names of dynasties, eras and groups (Ming, Han, Qing, Song, Jurassic, Confederate) right after "the" or "a", where a noun like Dynasty, Army or period comes next.

modes.label: Chinese dynasties
modes.description: A dynasty name such as Ming, Han, Qing or Song just before "Dynasty" or a ruler or official.
modes.example: He is regarded as one of the Four Great Masters of the<< Ming>> Dynasty.

modes.label: Other eras and groups
modes.description: A period or affiliation name such as Jurassic, Presbyterian, Republican, Catholic or Confederate that is followed by a noun.

card.writes: It favors period words such as dynasty, early period, mid-period and fall of, and suppresses other specific dynasty names.
card.plain: It marks a dynasty or era name that is about to be followed by a word like dynasty or period.
